_metadata.purpose: Wave-2 B3a curated variant-hint reference. Deterministic, $0 disambiguator consulted ONLY by the WARM-CONTEXT cache-write veto (warmer_write_veto) to close the 2+1 warmer-writable poison classes: gender_flanker_base_to_femme, spf_one_sided_add, makeup_one_sided_formula_add. These 3 classes PASS should_cache_price (they pass _selection_match -- the HELD display tradeoffs), so the cron warmer would otherwise cache a wrong-SKU price under the genuine 7d TTL.
_metadata.semantics: Base-line keyed by longest-key CONTAINMENT match on the folded (lowercase, NFKD-diacritic) query/candidate text. A candidate that ADDS an axis token the query lacks is checked against the base line's reference: DISTINCT -> the add makes it a different SKU (veto the write); SAME -> the add is descriptive of the same product (allow the write); a base-line MISS -> UNKNOWN (fail-closed: veto the write).
_metadata.invariants: The veto fires ONLY off-clock (WARMER_CONTEXT env / explicit warm_context=True) AND only when variant_descriptor_axes_enabled(). The live 15s path + is_price_showable display are UNTOUCHED (the HELD tolerances stand). A vetoed price still RESOLVES + DISPLAYS -- the warmer merely skips caching that row.
_metadata.provenance: Follows the data/bh_gcc_sources.json committed-data precedent. Seed generously with common GCC-market lines; a MISS is fail-closed so under-coverage costs a skipped warm, never a wrong cache.

fragrance_base_gender._comment: Base fragrance line -> the inherent gender of its UNSTATED base. A candidate that ADDS a gender token CONTRADICTING this base gender = DISTINCT flanker (Versace Eros [men] -> 'Eros Pour Femme' = a different women's SKU). A candidate whose added gender token MATCHES the base gender = SAME (Black Opium [women] -> 'Black Opium For Women'). Keyed by base-line containment.

inherent_spf_lines._comment: Skincare/sunscreen product lines whose BASE inherently carries SPF. A candidate that ADDS an SPF the query omits is the SAME product (the SPF is the base's inherent property). A base NOT in this list + an SPF add = DISTINCT (a non-sunscreen cream vs its SPF variant). Membership means 'an SPF add here is SAME'.
inherent_spf_lines._non_sunscreen_comment: Known NON-sunscreen skincare lines whose SPF variant is a DISTINCT SKU (base cream vs its SPF-added variant). A base matched here + an SPF add = DISTINCT. A base in NEITHER list = UNKNOWN (fail-closed).

makeup_formula_lines._comment: Makeup lines with DISTINCT formula sub-lines. A candidate that ADDS a formula-line token the query lacks = DISTINCT (Fit Me Matte Poreless vs Fit Me Dewy Smooth are different SKUs). Value is the set of distinct formula tokens; if the candidate adds one of these that the query does not carry, the SKUs differ.
